const key = "foo";
const index = 1;
interface Named {
  [key]: number;
  readonly [index]: string;
}
const wrong: Named = { foo: "no", 1: "a" };
const missing: Named = { 1: "a" };
const named: Named = { foo: 1, 1: "a" };
named[1] = "b";
type Literal = { [key](): number };
const literal: Literal = { foo: () => "x" };
console.log(wrong, missing, literal);
